description: Governor's Office - Western Province - Extended of period of Investigation of Single Person Inquiry Board for Wattala-Mabola Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the extension of an inquiry being conducted by a judicial officer (retired Judge of the Court of Appeal) into potential offenses committed by a local government body and its chairman. The content focuses on a law enforcement/judicial investigation process, the appointment of a judicial officer to conduct the inquiry, and the extension of its timeframe, falling squarely under Judicial/Law Enforcement matters.
